   DISSIPATING AS A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE OVER LAND
   VECTOR TO 36 HR POSIT: 345 DEG/ 09 KTS
    ---
   36 HRS, VALID AT:
   271200Z --- 27.8N 112.8E
   MAX SUSTAINED WINDS - 020 KT, GUSTS 030 KT

REMARKS:
260300Z POSITION NEAR 23.2N 114.3E.
26JUL26. TYPHOON 11W (NOUL), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 40 NM NORTH-
NORTHEAST OF HONG KONG, HAS TRACKED NORTHWESTWARD AT 07 KNOTS
OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS. ANIMATED MULTISPECTRAL SATELLITE
IMAGERY (MSI) AND RADAR IMAGERY DEPICT SPIRAL BANDS OF DEEP
CONVECTION PERSISTING AROUND THE CENTRAL VORTEX AS TYPHOON (TY)
11W TRACKS INLAND OVER SOUTHEASTERN CHINA. THE MSI AND RADAR
ALSO CONFIRM THAT THE EYE HAS FILLED COMPLETELY. THE SYSTEM IS
FORECAST TO CONTINUE TRACKING NORTH-NORTHWESTWARD AS IT
RAPIDLY DECAYS OVER LAND. DESPITE THE RAPID WEAKENING OF TY
11W, HEAVY PRECIPITATION IS EVIDENT IN THE RADAR AND WIND
SPEEDS OF 30 KTS GUSTING TO 40 KTS HAVE BEEN REPORTED IN HONG
KONG OVER THE PAST FEW HOURS. NUMERICAL MODEL GUIDANCE IS IN
TIGHT AGREEMENT ABOUT THE TRACK AND DISSIPATION OF THE SYSTEM
OVER THE NEXT 36 HOURS. THIS IS THE FINAL WARNING ON THIS
SYSTEM BY THE JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI. THE SYSTEM
WILL BE CLOSELY MONITORED FOR SIGNS OF REGENERATION.
MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE AT 260000Z IS 976 MB.//
